answer: Work history is time-locked: an identity's standing matures only after several epochs of accepted receipts, and a recruit that misbehaves burns the sponsor's accrued time. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so replaying a receipt from the tundra of old epochs does nothing. Hence a farm must run a grove of accounts for months before any of them can vouch, and one bad clone resets the sponsor's record to bare shale.
